svg.title: bulicmatko/dotfiles
svg.desc: The guided installer and the Brewfile picker beside dotfiles-doctor and the Claude Code status line, all in Tokyo Night Storm.

g.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

text.tspan: Package manager used for everything in the Brewfile.
Pick which Brewfile formulae and casks to install.
Choose and install applications from the Brewfile?
Set up zsh (links ~/.zshrc into this repo)?

g.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

text.tspan: Select applications to install (all selected by default)
space toggle · ↑/↓ move · a all · n none · enter confirm
starship — the prompt — configured in settings/starship/ (installed)
fzf — fuzzy finder — Ctrl-R history, **<Tab> completion (installed)
zoxide — smarter cd — `z dotf` jumps to ~/Projects/dotfiles (installed)
eza — modern ls — git status, icons (aliased in zshrc) (installed)
bat — cat with syntax highlighting and paging (installed)
tree — print directory trees in the terminal
ripgrep — rg — very fast recursive grep (installed)
git-delta — syntax-highlighted git diff pager (wired per machine)
